title: Penguin dancing
svg:
<svg viewBox="0 0 100 100" xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- Left flipper raised -->
  <ellipse cx="22" cy="42" rx="10" ry="5" fill="#5D6D9E" transform="rotate(-60 22 42)"/>
  <!-- Right flipper out -->
  <ellipse cx="78" cy="48" rx="10" ry="5" fill="#5D6D9E" transform="rotate(30 78 48)"/>
  <!-- Body -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="62" rx="24" ry="30" fill="#5D6D9E"/>
  <!-- White belly -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="66" rx="15" ry="20" fill="#E8EEFF"/>
  <!-- Head -->
  <circle cx="50" cy="30" r="16" fill="#5D6D9E"/>
  <!-- White face patch -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="32" rx="11" ry="10" fill="#E8EEFF"/>
  <!-- Left eye -->
  <circle cx="45" cy="29" r="2.5" fill="#1A1A2E"/>
  <circle cx="46" cy="28" r="0.8" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <!-- Right eye -->
  <circle cx="55" cy="29" r="2.5" fill="#1A1A2E"/>
  <circle cx="56" cy="28" r="0.8" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <!-- Beak -->
  <polygon points="48,34 52,34 50,38" fill="#FFB347"/>
  <!-- Left foot lifted -->
  <ellipse cx="36" cy="92" rx="9" ry="5" fill="#FFB347" transform="rotate(-15 36 92)"/>
  <!-- Right foot planted -->
  <ellipse cx="62" cy="93" rx="10" ry="5" fill="#FF8C42"/>
  <!-- Musical notes -->
  <g fill="#FF6B9D">
    <circle cx="80" cy="22" r="3"/>
    <rect x="82" y="10" width="2" height="13" rx="1"/>
    <circle cx="16" cy="18" r="2.5"/>
    <rect x="18" y="8" width="1.8" height="11" rx="0.9"/>
  </g>
  <!-- Dance lines -->
  <g stroke="#FFD93D" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-linecap="round">
    <line x1="12" y1="55" x2="16" y2="50"/>
    <line x1="8" y1="62" x2="13" y2="58"/>
    <line x1="88" y1="60" x2="84" y2="55"/>
    <line x1="92" y1="68" x2="87" y2="63"/>
  </g>
</svg>
